# Typing main selects it over the lower-scoring current branch.
# https://github.com/abhinav/git-spice/issues/1446

init

await 'my-awesome-improvement-new ◀'

feed main
feed <Enter>

-- branches --
[
  {"branch": "main"},
  {"branch": "my-awesome-improvement-new", "base": "main"}
]
-- selected --
my-awesome-improvement-new
-- want --
main
